input_policy.adaptation: Malik six-qubit angle circuit and class-level forgetting; not amplitude encoding or binary sampling
input_policy.normalization: all clean/corrupt inputs divided by 255 then per-record L2 normalized before PCA
input_policy.pca: four components; fit on the model's training records only; original refit policy
input_policy.replacement: full 784-vector, real N(0, 0.1**2), then unit L2 norm
